extension.summary: Your Seren (Trakt) movie and series collection as a Kodi library, updated at once from Lucent
Je Seren (Trakt) film- en seriecollectie als Kodi-bibliotheek, direct bij te werken vanuit Lucent
extension.description:
Reads the movies of your Trakt collection from Seren and writes a small .strm and .nfo file for each, so Kodi shows them in its own library (collections grouped, loose films between them). Playing a film starts Seren.
IMPORTANT: first load your whole collection in Seren (Movies > My movies (collection) and TV shows > My shows (collection)) until everything is in. Lucent Library only takes over what Seren already knows; titles Seren has not loaded yet are added on a later run.

Leest de films van je Trakt-collectie uit Seren en maakt per film een klein .strm- en .nfo-bestand, zodat Kodi ze in zijn eigen bibliotheek toont (collecties gegroepeerd, losse films ertussen). Een film afspelen start Seren.
BELANGRIJK: laad eerst je hele collectie in Seren (Films > Mijn films (collectie) en Series > Mijn series (collectie)) tot alles binnen is. Lucent Bibliotheek neemt alleen over wat Seren al kent; titels die Seren nog niet geladen heeft, komen er bij een volgende ronde bij.
extension.news: 1.15.0: your own Trakt lists can be the library (Skin settings > Lucent Library > Use my lists as library): choose a list for films and one for series; their titles come into the Kodi library next to the Trakt collection, without its limit. Long lists are read page by page; if Trakt does not answer, the last copy is used so nothing disappears. 1.14.18: a series or film you add gets its poster, backdrop, logo, cast and episode pictures from TMDb straight away (before, Kodi showed a folder icon until you refreshed it by hand); titles already in the library without pictures get them on the next run. With "hide until you can watch it" on, series stay out of the rows until their first episode has aired (films: until their digital release). 1.14.17: Lucent's own TMDb and Trakt rows give up to 60 / 100 titles instead of 20, so the skin's Number of titles (50, 100, All) works for them; RunScript(script.lucent.library,widgets_stale) fetches every saved row again. 1.14.16: Library rows with series also work on Kodi 20 (no series status there). The library rows Continue watching and New in your collection can show only films or only series (for a Films or Series tab). 1.14.15: Hide films until their digital release (switch in Lucent: Menu and widgets): films that are only in cinemas or not out yet stay out of the Home rows until TMDb has a digital (or disc) release date that has passed; library titles always show. 1.14.14: The Seren options in the context menu now also appear on films in the Lucent rows on Home (TMDb and Trakt lists). Films and episodes remember where you stopped, on this device: the position is saved while you watch, and when you start the same title again (from the library, a row or Seren) it continues there. The film or episode in the Kodi library also gets that point (progress bar, Resume). Watched to the end: the point is removed. 1.14.13: The Seren options are now straight in the context menu of a library film or episode (no submenu): search again (rescrape), search again and choose a source, choose a source, find similar, browse the series, Trakt manager. They also appear on Seren items when Seren's own context menu is switched off. 1.14.12: Films and episodes in the library continue where you stopped: the library files now ask Seren to look up your resume point (Seren only does that when asked, so they always started at the beginning). The files are rewritten at the next library run, a few minutes after Kodi starts. 1.14.11: Films and episodes in the Kodi library get a Seren menu in the context menu (long press OK or the menu button): choose a source, search again (rescrape), Trakt manager, and for an episode: open the series in Seren. 1.14.10: Streaming services switched off in Lucent stay out of the row. 1.14.9: Streaming services: Prime Video added; the row uses the logos and animations that Lucent 1.31.58 brings. 1.14.8: After watching a film or an episode, what Trakt counts as watched gets its watched mark in the Kodi library within a minute (it waited for the next library run, hours later), and the Home rows show it. The streaming services row gives the skin the transparent logos for its tiles. 1.14.7: A series in a Lucent TMDb row opens straight on its seasons (with Lucent 1.31.55). 1.14.6: Streaming services: the right logos at the top (from the studio logo packs: white for Apple TV+ and HBO Max, in colour for the others) instead of look-alikes such as Disney Jr. or Peacock Film. 1.14.5: The streaming services row follows your own choice of services and pictures when you made one in Lucent. 1.14.4: Streaming services: only Netflix, Disney+, HBO Max, Apple TV+, Hulu, Starz, Paramount+, Peacock, MGM+, AMC+ and Discovery+, in that order. A service your country does not have (Hulu, Peacock ...) shows its US lists. 1.14.3: Home rows now pass on the date a title was added, so a row can be sorted on it. 1.14.2: Clean-up of code that is no longer used. 1.14.1: Streaming services: a click opens the pop-up of the service; transparent service logos (logo pack, else TMDb). 1.14.0: Streaming services from TMDb: a row of services, a page per service with six lists, and every list as a fast row. 1.13.0: New episodes: every hour the library looks at your Trakt calendar; a new episode of a series in your library is added an hour after it was on TV, also when it is not in your Trakt collection (Seren only knew collected episodes). Switch off with Skin.SetBool(lucent.lib.newep.off). 1.12.0: The rows of every tab (not only the tab on screen) are fetched in the background after start, so a tab you open later is already filled. 1.11.0: No more "The Movie Database Python error ... Not Found" pop-ups: the library now writes the details Seren already has into the files instead of letting Kodi's TMDb scraper look every title up (a wrong TMDb number made the scraper fail). 1.10.1: Fast rows give the score under the names the skin reads (tmdb, trakt) so the score badges show; old saved copies are refreshed once so logos and scores appear. 1.10.0: Watched marks: the library now asks Trakt for your complete watched list itself, page by page (Trakt only gives 100 items per request since 2026, so Seren's copy can miss most of your history), and marks films and episodes as watched in the Kodi library from it; Trakt rows show the watched mark on films too. 1.9.3: Trakt rows show the Trakt score (with votes) next to the TMDb score. 1.9.2: Fast rows get clearlogo, genres, runtime, studio and vote count (TMDb details, saved), and are marked so clicking opens the Lucent page instead of Kodi's scraper. 1.9.1: An empty Trakt row now says why (no TMDb key, not logged in, Trakt error). 1.9.0: Trakt lists as fast Home rows too (watchlist, recommended, trending, anticipated, your own and liked lists), with pictures from TMDb. 1.8.0: Lucent's own Home rows straight from TMDb (trending, popular, top rated, in cinemas, coming soon, series on air): one request per list every 6 hours, saved copy shown at once, no other add-on involved. Pick them under Add row > Lucent fast lists. A click opens the title's page. 1.7.0: Home rows from add-ons (Seren and others) load reliably: the rows only show the saved copy and never start the add-on themselves; the service fetches them one at a time (rows without a copy first, refreshes later and not while you watch), gives up on a fetch that hangs after 45 seconds, keeps the good copy when a fetch fails and tries again later. Continue-watching rows refresh every 15 minutes and after you watched something, other rows every 6 hours. 1.6.5: Rows with library titles (Recently added, Continue watching ...) keep the title's library id, so OK / Info opens the info page again. 1.6.4: Take one episode or a whole season of a series out of the library (Lucent: Options > Remove from library): it stays out, also at the next update; nothing changes on Trakt, and adding the series again brings it back. 1.6.3: Setting the watched marks (and scores) now shows a progress bar at the top of the screen - "Watched marks: 150 of 1240" - and goes much faster: Kodi gets them 50 at a time instead of one by one. 1.6.2: The IMDb, Trakt and TMDB scores Seren shows now also appear for films and series in the Kodi library (also on the rows on Home and on the season page in Lucent). Kodi's TMDB scrapers only keep their own score; no new scan is needed. 1.6.1: New episodes come into the library one day after they were on TV - before that a source often has no link yet. Episodes that are already there stay. 1.6.0: Safer and lighter: a half-finished Seren sync never removes titles, a title only goes after it has been missing for 3 hours, new titles that Seren has not shown yet still get added, only the Lucent folders are scanned and cleaned, watched marks go to Trakt in one batch, and runs can no longer overlap. 1.5.4: Note added: first load your whole collection in Seren, Lucent Library only takes over what Seren already knows. 1.5.3: The message with the number of films and series after updating is back; one odd title no longer stops the whole run. 1.5.0: Add a title to Trakt and the Kodi library at once from Lucent, Home rows from the Kodi library, watched marks to Trakt, Surprise me, settings in Lucent.
